steps.label: 3. Check waits
steps.sub: What is SQL Server actually waiting on, before you guess

code:
SELECT TOP 10 wait_type, wait_time_ms, waiting_tasks_count,
       wait_time_ms / waiting_tasks_count AS avg_wait_ms
FROM sys.dm_os_wait_stats
WHERE wait_time_ms > 0
ORDER BY wait_time_ms DESC;
caption: Instance-wide: what has this server spent the most time waiting on?
